answer.rationale: With expiry in 14 days, no auto-renew, and the line at 94% with no buffer, switching primary vendors is too delivery-risky despite memory_c2's prior savings. Deferral is not viable because supply continuity would lapse. Adding a second source helps resilience but is unlikely to deliver the mandated 18% component-spend cut within this cycle and may raise near-term qualification cost. Negotiating terms at incumbent renewal best matches the objective: memory_c1 supports continuity/stability, memory_c4 supports benchmark-driven recovery of price and payment terms, and memory_c6 suggests volume/multi-year levers may unlock pricing without narrowing service. Verify memory_c4 because the intended cost mechanism depends on whether renewal renegotiation truly recovered margin.
